# Reference cases for plt-raster, rendered by matplotlib's RendererAgg
# (generate.py) and by plt-raster (tests/agg_reference.rs).
#
#   case <name> <width> <height> [tol=<max abs channel diff>]
#   path <id> <M|L|Q|C|Z tokens in device pixels, y down>
#   <op> <path id or -> key=value...
#   end
#
# Ops: fill, stroke, hatch, markers, gouraud, image, text. Images are
# drawn with alpha 1 because RendererAgg's wrapper forces gc.alpha = 1
# (matplotlib bakes image alpha into the pixels). Colours are
# r,g,b,a in [0, 1]; clip=x0,y0,x1,y1 is a device-space clip rectangle;
# clippath=<id> clips with a path. Coordinates are dyadic so matplotlib's
# y flip is exact. Strokes stay inside the canvas so matplotlib's
# PathClipper leaves them untouched.

case fill_triangle 32 32

fill p color=1,0,0,1
end

end

end
